elliptic_fourier — SHAPE2D descriptor op

• Data kinds: pairs → efdmodel

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.elliptic_fourier(points, n_harmonics=10) (to call the implementation directly, import fourierdesc; fourierdesc.elliptic_fourier(points, n_harmonics=10); from the registry, opsshape2d.get("elliptic_fourier"))

Usage

Computes the elliptic Fourier coefficients of a closed contour using the Kuhl–Giardina closed form.

Arguments:

points: (N,2) closed-contour vertices. If not closed, the first point is appended at the end internally.

n_harmonics: number of harmonics N (the more, the finer the detail represented).

Returns: dict

"coeffs": (N,4) array. Row n is [a_n, b_n, c_n, d_n]. "a0", "c0": DC components (centre offset of the contour).

"n_harmonics": N.

The reconstruction reconstruct is x(t)=a0+Σ a_n cos(2πnt)+b_n sin(2πnt), y(t)=c0+Σ c_n cos+d_n sin (t∈[0,1)).
